title: Decide whether an agent earned production exposure
description: Choose a trajectory pattern, vary the evidence volume and step budget, and inspect which independent gates support or block a bounded release.

scenarios.label: Controlled support agent
scenarios.detail: External state agrees with the final claim, tools are reliable, and failed calls recover within budget.

scenarios.label: Confident false completion
scenarios.detail: The agent often announces success before the authoritative system contains the requested state.

scenarios.label: Retry-heavy booking agent
scenarios.detail: The final state is usually correct, but malformed calls and unbounded retries increase cost and duplicate-action risk.

scenarios.label: High-completion scope creep
scenarios.detail: The agent completes the task but sometimes accesses resources outside the declared permission boundary.
